independent_acceptance_review.summary: All four reported issues survive independent checks of hypotheses and quantifiers. The smooth prescribed complete-intersection fiber refutes Claim25.2 and invalidates the displayed gluing dependency into Theorems1-2, supporting Major without refuting those theorems. The disconnected-handle, free-union and residue-degree/count counterexamples are genuine local Minor findings. Unresolved field and global-repair questions remain unresolved rather than confirmed defects.

problem_checks.assumptions: Complex field,P2,H=O(2)=2A; two distinct markedpoints inP2xP1 with coincident projections at0; reduced baseA1 and smooth prescribed Hci fiber.
problem_checks.independent_derivation: OnQ0=[-u^2:uv:v^2], the(2,2) equation becomesu^4 S^2+v^4 SW+(uv^3+u^4)W^2. Coefficients have no common zero. A repeated discriminant root would forcez^3=-5/8,z^5=2/3, incompatible atz^15. Atu=0 the fiberSW=0 contains both marks. Incidence at(0,0),(t,0) forcesa00=0 andt a10+t^2 a20=0, hencea10(0)=0, contrary toQ0=x+y^2. The cancellation survives dominant ramified base change.
problem_checks.counterevidence_and_impact: The source places no constant-rank restriction on projected marks. Extra contracted base components might support a different theorem but are absent in the false fixed-base claim. The printed gluing proof explicitly uses it in the main chain; the main theorems themselves are not disproved.
problem_checks.repair: Restricted constant-rank or altered-family/base constructions need additional proofs; none certified as complete.
